chromaKeyPolicy.rule: Each standalone chromakey source asset uses a flat key color selected so the key does not appear in that asset. Runtime PNGs are transparent.

assetProduction.rule: HUD runtime assets are extracted from individual production-quality imagegen source files, one source file per asset. They are not atlas/sheet crops, not crops from screenshot references, and not programmatic SVG/vector/placeholder drawings. They must not bake numbers, labels, semantic state icons, filled progress bars, or gameplay state into the art.

farm.reason: Farm remains hidden legacy in the registry; a new panel surface is kept for compatibility only.
